Sample generated chart

A practice chart made the same way as in a match: trades one by one, each buying or selling SOL through a constant-product pool. The chart is made in this browser from the seed below; the same seed always gives the same chart. The numbers come from generated-chart-config.js.

Top: price (100 = start). Bottom: SOL traded each bar, buys (green, upwards) and sells (red, downwards).
